subject: general
question: A train crosses a pole in 80 seconds. If the speed of the train is 36 km/h, then the length of the train is:
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the train = 36 km/h

Time to cross the pole = 80 seconds

**Formula Used:**

Length of the train = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

First, convert the speed from km/h to m/s:

1 km/h = 5/18 m/s

Speed = 36 km/h × 5/18

⇒ Speed = 36 × 5 / 18

⇒ Speed = 10 m/s

Now, calculate the length of the train:

Length of the train = Speed × Time

⇒ Length of the train = 10 m/s × 80 s

⇒ Length of the train = 800 meters

**The length of the train is 800 meters.**
